name: Tiny Aya En-Thinker and L2-Thinker

lineage.base_model: CohereLabs/tiny-aya-base-32K (stated on the base card as the base of both thinkers)
lineage.how_derived: supervised fine-tuning after pretraining: En-Thinker reasons in English; L2-Thinker reasons in the language of the prompt (44 languages plus English in-language, 20+ more via non-reasoning instruction data), per the L2 card text. The base is a pretrained-only model (not instruction-tuned) with 32K context versus 8K for tiny-aya-base; the card does not say how the 32K was reached.

purpose: An open-weights research release of a 3.35 B multilingual reasoning model for math, science, general reasoning, instruction following and multilingual open-ended generation; En-Thinker reasons in English and answers in the user's language, L2-Thinker thinks in the language of the prompt (German is among its 44 in-language languages), and the pair supports research comparing English reasoning with target-language reasoning.

license.name: CC-BY-NC-4.0 plus Cohere Labs Acceptable Use Policy
license.notes: Tag and card summary: non-commercial; commercial use goes through Cohere sales. Files are gated, license text not read (2026-11-19). Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: dense auto-regressive transformer (Tiny Aya / Cohere family)
architecture.attention: interleaved sliding-window and global-attention layers with rotary positions (base card summary)

variants.notes: gated; card text read through a summarizing fetch: thinking in the prompt language, sampling temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, max_new_tokens 32768; main branch has extra training so the model states its name, intermediate checkpoints in ckpt-xxx branches (last ckpt-61875)
gated; pretrained base of both thinkers, text completion prompts (no chat template); card names 70+ languages with emphasis on high-resource European languages and 32K context; no benchmark numbers

soft.behavior: Thinking on by default; enable_thinking=False skips it; the card recommends capping max_new_tokens because thinking traces can be long.
weaknesses: No benchmark numbers on the card page
soft.maturity: Under 300 downloads per repo in two and a half months; arXiv 2609.10445 linked in tags.

tona_fit.reason: Small multilingual reasoning models (3.35B) that fit every class, but no coding focus and no benchmark numbers recorded.
